content:
iOS 27 will roll out to all users next week, with the first iOS 27.1 beta and final release following shortly after. Here's the expected timeline for iOS 27.1.

iOS 27.1 is set to launch in October, alongside the iPhone Duo, with the beta expected about a week later.

If you're not already on Apple's beta program, note that a major iPhone software update is coming next week.

iOS 27 officially arrives this Monday (September 14), bringing features like Siri AI.

However, if you've been running the iOS 27 beta all summer, you're probably already looking ahead to iOS 27.1.

Apple is expected to seed the first iOS 27.1 beta roughly a week after iOS 27 launches. Here's the recent history:

  • iOS 26.1 beta shipped 7 days after iOS 26
  • iOS 17.1 beta shipped 9 days after iOS 17
  • iOS 16.1 beta shipped 2 days after iOS 16

I'm excluding iOS 18 because Apple pushed the 18.1 beta earlier that summer specifically to test Apple Intelligence.

Based on the pattern, iOS 27.1 beta 1 could arrive as early as next week and no later than the week of September 21.

So when does the final version drop?

Apple confirmed this week that iOS 27.1 will release on or before October 23, and it could even land a few days earlier.

Its iPhone Duo press release states: "iPhone Duo will launch with iOS 27.1." Since the iPhone Duo doesn't reach users until October 23, the software update has to be out by then.

That's actually a bit earlier than usual. Going back to 2025, Apple's x.1 updates over the past four years landed on November 3, October 28, October 25, and October 24.

Given iOS 27.1 needs to ship in time for the iPhone Duo, the most likely release window for the final build is between Monday, October 19 and Wednesday, October 21.

Aside from iPhone Duo-specific features, the contents of this update aren't yet clear. We'll update you once the first beta is out.
